title: Statistics on Total Employment and Trade Income of Top 1,000 Earners
what_it_is: Statistics on Total Employment and Trade Income of Top 1,000 Earners

sections.label: Top 1,000 earners income percentiles
sections.summary: For YA2023, YA2019 and YA2014, the 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile income of the top 1,000 Singapore Citizen earners are stated.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: For YA2023, the 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile income of the top 1,000 earners who are Singapore Citizens are $2.4 million, $2.9 million and $4.5 million respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: For YA2019, the corresponding figures are $2 million, $2.5 million and $3.6 million.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance):
sentences.text: For YA2014, the corresponding figures are $1.8 million, $2.2 million and $3 million.
